description: After a statement exceeds a resource limit inside a transaction, what does the commit continuation keep? Before OpenDatabase, DBEngine.SetOption(62 = dbMaxLocksPerFile, 5) in this process only. Workspaces(0).BeginTrans; known changes a, b, c (V = 101/202/303 for ID 1/2/3); UPDATE Big SET V = V + 1 over 1000 rows (dbFailOnError); Database.RecordsAffected; DBEngine.Errors; read T and the count/sum of Big; then CommitTrans, DBEngine.Errors, read T and Big again, close; finally T and Big through a fresh Workspace. This is lock-count exhaustion, not a TEMP-volume fault.
retentionNote: Designed r-txn-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
